title: Interactive ward unregister for this checkout binding
description: DEC-217 / ODOC-488 step 2b: interactive trusted-terminal command removing this checkout binding only; removes its profile approvals only after a second confirmation. Refuses when unbound; never touches another root binding. Supersedes the ADR 0005 no-unregister statement.

acceptanceCriteria.text: ward unregister removes only the current checkout binding
Its profile approvals are removed only after a second confirmation
It refuses when the checkout is not bound and in a non-interactive terminal
Registered in ward manifest --json and help

implementationNotes: Built per DEC-217 Q4, recorded as ADR 0022 (ADR 0005 marked superseded in part). For review: declining the second question keeps approvals, and registering the same directory again revives them until expiry or revoke; DEC-217 does not say, and the report states it. It is admin in the manifest and needs no manifest file. Stacked on WCLI-72, itself on WCLI-12 (opum-ai/ward-cli#149); no PR until those land.
